channels.label: Local Market
checks: buyer acceptance and applicable local quality requirements
channels.reason: Visible appearance and the assigned grade can support a local-market candidate, subject to buyer checks.

channels.label: Export
channels.reason: Export eligibility cannot be established from visual inspection; confirm importer and official requirements.

channels.label: Premium Sale
channels.reason: A premium outlet is only a candidate when the visible appearance and completeness support buyer review.

channels.label: Processed/Canned
checks: processing suitability and required food-safety tests
channels.reason: Processing may be a practical outlet, but suitability and food-safety requirements need external confirmation.

channels.label: Poultry Feed
channels.reason: A feed outlet remains subject to validated feed-safety rules and buyer acceptance.
